pre386_fallback.scope: Matched production EMM386 rejection and DEVICEHIGH/LOADHIGH/MemMaker fallback on 86Box 286. Ordinary baseline full 286 acceptance is recorded separately.

default_full_suite.scope: Default selected media and all Make test prerequisites. Some focused layout fixtures and native command contracts intentionally build/use baseline or diagnostic artifacts; the matched campaign above independently qualifies the selected memory core.

reproducibility.scope: Pristine baseline artifacts and selected production core built together on the pinned host tools.

fresh_default_build.initial_comparison: Fresh build and its media checks passed; initial cross-workspace media comparison differed solely in SCANDISK.INI line endings. Comparison passed after normalizing the root checkout to its declared CRLF policy.

resource_normalization.scope: Configuration resource only; no executable change. SCANDISK trim() removes both CR and LF.

front.contract: split escaped entries, canonical policy and transfer scratch
stable header; initialization body has boot-only lifetime
keep discovery and A20 recovery callable without high dispatch
public wrapper; local bodies and records belong to bootstrap
retain real-mode chain and reported pool contract
preserve cached entry, caller frame and XMS 2/3 outputs
one live reservation bit; HMA is not a second allocator pool
keep transition recovery independent of enabled A20/high services
boot negotiation; retain a defined response after retirement
retire only after all live calls and cancellation end
permanent freeze/publication guard; import body is bootstrap-only
one lifetime gate; local target table is bootstrap-only
bootstrap/high lifetime selection; never enter retired storage

front.owner: UMB import gate and publication state
front.contract: import body is bootstrap-only; keep outcome state and permanent rejection
one resident guarded entry per boot; no fallback after binding
shared input snapshot, serialization and sequenced results
retain lifetime checks; bootstrap body/state are separately owned

charge final packing, not a payload owner

transplant_counterfactual.note: Hypothetical deletion with current transports and alignment retained; excludes EMM, high costs and replacement interfaces. Not reclaimable bytes.

himem.identity_note: Input hashes identify supplied files; not proof they were assembled together.

owner_checks.scope: Paired HIMEM owner accounting, linked BIOS/COMMAND checks and campaign live EMM table ownership. Ordinary layout limits apply only to their matching baseline; speculative capacity inventories are not additional achieved relocation.

resource_normalization.scope: Configuration resource only; no executable change. SCANDISK trim() removes both CR and LF.

final_media.scope: Canonical installation media have CRLF SCANDISK.INI; candidate campaign and full suite used the same configuration text with LF. Executable core is byte-identical. Canonical distribution validation and fixed-disk SYS boot checks passed after normalization.

explicit_limits: DBCS, external hooks and third-party providers beyond exercised contracts remain scoped.
Emulators do not qualify physical A20 controllers, media timing or every chipset.
Application lifecycle qualification covers the recorded programs and workloads, not exhaustive DOS software compatibility.
Further relocation, HMA/UMB repacking and EBDA recovery remain deferred optimization, not release blockers.
DriveSpace, QBASIC/EDIT, AccessDOS, Network Client and additional locale packs remain separate epics.
